summary: The repair is successful. The updated roster contains 10 distinct video-local targets and excludes both former black-minivan duplicate references. All 29 retained events bind to the renumbered targets, show an allowed activity, and remain aligned to montage-relative timestamps. No remaining reference collision or obvious missed qualifying event was found.

methodology.independence: No other visual reviewer report was read or used.
methodology.scope: Focused repair re-audit because the montage is unchanged and only roster/ground-truth membership and numbering changed.
methodology.roster_review: Inspected all 10 updated roster JPEGs and verified one-to-one IDs reference_001 through reference_010. Compared each crop directly to its action scene at native 1920x1080 resolution.
methodology.event_review: Decoded frames before, during, and after every retained interval, not merely a subset: 29 of 29 events were checked. Dense 0.5 s sequences were used for crowded gym bindings and temporal continuity.
methodology.collision_review: Explicitly compared co-scene pairs reference_005/reference_010 (120-180 s), reference_007/reference_009 (240-300 s), and reference_004/reference_008 (480-540 s). They are distinct by clothing, location, and simultaneous/continuous trajectories. The former 433-449 s black-minivan subject has no updated roster reference.
methodology.timestamp_basis: All event times were interpreted as seconds from montage start and checked against decoded montage frames.
methodology.label_basis: Only the six instruction-defined labels were accepted; overlapping pickup/carry/put-down and vehicle entry/door closure were checked separately.
methodology.omission_check: Revisited each retained target-local scene and the former duplicate scene for obvious allowed activities outside the 29 listed intervals. No missed candidate attributable to an updated roster target was found.
methodology.limitations: References 007, 009, and 010 are relatively small or low-detail in crowded gym views. At native 1080p, temporal tracking and scene position remain sufficient for an evaluated agent; this is a difficulty observation, not a repair issue.

nonblocking_observations.finding: Small, low-detail, or intermittently occluded gym targets increase difficulty, but each remains identifiable at native 1080p through temporal continuity and scene context.
